A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed techniques to automatically detect the solo voice from a music audio signal, extract the voice signal from its accompaniment and identify the lyrics sung by the voice.
we have developed techniques to extract vocal-related information from music audio signals and to use the information for the realization of the above three functions.
we have developed a framework of techniques for extracting vocal-related information to support the realization of a digital library for popular music collections.

a music digital library can be built upon a content-based processing of the music audio signals.
